Minnesota State Fair
events.description: A cherished end-of-summer tradition, the Minnesota State Fair welcomes 1.8 million guests annually. A world-class showcase of agriculture, entertainment, food, art and industry.

events.name: Dinner Du Nord
events.description: Dine at America's longest dinner table, one stretching seven blocks. Enjoy your choice of signature dishes from a variety of over 40 Minneapolis restaurants and food trucks, served al fresco on the bus-free Mall.

events.name: Taste of Greece Festival
events.description: Each year, the Taste of Greece Festival welcomes more than 30,000 attendees, transforming St. Mary's Greek Orthodox Church into a lively 'horio' (Greek village) filled with authentic Greek flavors, live music, dancing and 'kefi' – the joyful spirit of Greek culture.

events.name: Minneapolis Monarch Festival
events.description: The Minneapolis Monarch Festival celebrates the monarch butterfly's 2,300 mile migration from Minnesota to Mexico with music, food, dance, hands-on art and native plant sales.

events.name: Open Streets West Broadway
events.venue: West Broadway (Logan Avenue to Lyndale Avenue North)
events.description: Open Streets West Broadway is a free, family-friendly event that offers a variety of activities such as biking, walking, playing, eating, dancing, and singing. The event covers 13 blocks on West Broadway and attracts over 250 participants and vendors with over 3,000 attendees.

events.name: Minnesota Vikings vs. Green Bay Packers
events.description: The Minnesota Vikings open their season at U.S. Bank Stadium with a game against the Green Bay Packers.

events.name: Taco Tour on Lake Street
events.description: Celebrate the street where Minneapolis' soul stretches wide, where global flavors meet Midwestern familiarity, and every bite supports immigrant entrepreneurs who have enriched our neighborhood at the annual Taco Tour on Lake Street.

events.name: Art on the Edge Festival
events.description: Enjoy a full day of art, creativity, and soulful connection at the 5th Annual Art on The Edge Festival, now taking place next to the stunning Father Hennepin Bluff Park, right beside the Stone Arch Bridge in Minneapolis.

events.name: Mamma Mia!
events.description: Set on a Greek island paradise where the sun always shines, a tale of love, friendship and identity is beautifully told through the timeless hits of ABBA. On the eve of her wedding, a daughter's quest to discover the father she's never known brings three men from her mother's past back to the island they last visited decades ago.

events.name: John Crist Live
events.description: Combining sharp wit, tactfully unhinged stand-up and viral sketches, John Crist is one of today's most distinctive, fastest-rising comedic voices. With more than one billion video views and 8 million followers, he consistently ranks among Pollstar's Top 10 Global Touring Comedians.

events.name: MODE: The World's Photography Festival
events.description: MODE is a photography festival unlike any other: A three-day party across downtown Minneapolis dedicated to art, experimentation, and community. Try gear you've been eyeing, join a photo walk at sunrise, catch a sold-out concert, and more.

events.name: Kacey Musgraves

events.name: Twin Cities Arab Film Festival
events.venue: The Main Cinema and Walker Art Center
events.description: Mizna celebrates the 20th edition of the Twin Cities Arab Film Festival. The festival continues to consider what has been overlooked, discovering liberatory lessons the past might offer the present and future, presenting special screenings, guests, and more.

events.name: Cocktails at the Castle
events.description: More than just a night out, Cocktails at the Castle brings together a diverse community of music, art, and craft lovers at the Twin Cities' only castle. Explore the American Swedish Institute's historic Turnblad Mansion and festival grounds, featuring top local musicians, interactive art demos, food, curated cocktails and craft beers.

events.name: Dakota Block Party
events.description: Get jazzy in downtown Minneapolis at the Dakota Block Party. The festival will feature a lineup of more than a dozen musical acts throughout the afternoon and evening, along with food and beverage offerings, a local Makers' Market, and kids 'Treble Makers' play area with family-friendly activities. This is a free, all-ages celebration.
